refinements.name: 天才的扈从
refinements.description: 装备者的冲击力提升30点，造成的伤害无视目标15%火属性伤害抗性；装备者为非操作中角色时，能量自动回复提升0.4点/秒；装备者发动[强化特殊技]造成火属性伤害时，使全队代理人造成的伤害提升12.5%，持续30秒，最多叠加2层，重复触发时刷新持续时间，同一招式内最多触发1次，该效果全队唯一。
refinements.descriptionEn: The equipper's Impact increases by 30, and their DMG ignores 15% of the target's Fire RES. When the equipper is not the active character, Energy Regen increases by 0.4/s. When the equipper deals Fire DMG with an EX Special Attack, all Agents' DMG increases by 12.5% for 30s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. This effect can trigger once per skill. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：嗯呢弹幕
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
驾驶炮塔连续射击并根据敌人状态发射不同类型的导弹：
主要攻击目标未处于失衡状态时，发射破甲弹头，造成火属性伤害并累积较多失衡值；
主要攻击目标处于失衡状态时，发射高爆弹头，造成更高火属性伤害；
招式发动后，诺姆获得16%[预热膛温]，并进入[嗯呢弹幕]状态，持续32秒，[嗯呢弹幕]状态期间，诺姆会放置两座[嗯呢炮塔]加入战斗；
保持长按可以持续消耗能量并延长最多2秒射击时间，每通过长按消耗1点能量，诺姆额外获得0.4%[预热膛温]，并使本轮[嗯呢弹幕]状态的持续时间额外增加0.8秒，最多增加32秒；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Operates the turret to fire continuously and launch different types of missiles based on the target's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launches an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing Fire DMG and inflicting a large amount of Daze.
When the primary target is Stunned, launches a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater Fire DMG.
After using this skill, Norma gains 16% Preheated Chamber and enters the En-Nah Barrage state for 32s. While En-Nah Barrage is active, Norma deploys two En-Nah Turrets to join the battle.
Continuing to hold extends the firing time by up to 2s, continuously consuming energy. For each 1 point of energy consumed while holding, Norma gains an additional 0.4% Preheated Chamber, and this round of En-Nah Barrage lasts 0.8s longer, up to a maximum additional duration of 32s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Commands the Rumble Drill to continuously drill the target, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Commands a swarm of Rumble Drills to deal multiple hits, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：优势火力学说

招式发动时，立刻获得30%[预热膛温]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Calls in tactical artillery to bombard enemies ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, immediately gains 30% Preheated Chamber.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:

quickAssist.descriptionEn:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 招式命中敌人时，将触发上一位角色的[快速支援]，5秒内最多触发一次；
facts.textEn: When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the previous character's Quick Assist. This effect can trigger once every 5s.

facts.text: [预热膛温]大于等于80%后，下次发动的[普通攻击：帽子把戏]将无视冷却时间限制触发[快速支援]，并消耗80%[预热膛温]将其替换为[连携技]。
facts.textEn: When Preheated Chamber is at least 80%, the next Basic Attack: Hat Trick can trigger a Quick Assist regardless of cooldown, and consumes 80% Preheated Chamber to replace the Quick Assist with a Chain Attack.

facts.text:
初始暴击率超过50%时，每超过1%，暴击伤害提升1.7%，最多额外提升85%；
初始暴击率超过50%时，每超过1%，[强化特殊技]、[特殊技]、[终结技]攻击命中敌人时，造成的失衡值提升0.8%，最多额外提升40%；
诺姆会根据自身贯穿力额外提升攻击力，每1点贯穿力将提升1.25点攻击力，最多提升1200点攻击力；
进入战场时，诺姆立刻获得60%[预热膛温]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
[预热膛温]大于等于80%后，下次发动的[普通攻击：帽子把戏]将无视冷却时间限制触发[快速支援]，并消耗80%[预热膛温]将其替换为[连携技]。
facts.textEn:
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases her CRIT DMG by 1.7%, up to a maximum increase of 85%.
When initial CRIT Rate exceeds 50%, every additional 1% increases the Daze dealt by her EX Special Attack, Special Attack, and Ultimate by 0.8% when they hit an enemy, up to a maximum increase of 40%.
Norma gains additional ATK based on her Sheer Force. Every 1 point of Sheer Force increases her ATK by 1.25, up to a maximum increase of 1,200 ATK.
Upon entering the battlefield, Norma immediately gains 60% Preheated Chamber. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When Preheated Chamber is at least 80%, the next Basic Attack: Hat Trick can trigger a Quick Assist regardless of cooldown, and consumes 80% Preheated Chamber to replace the Quick Assist with a Chain Attack.

cinema.name: 激进远视主义
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：火力实验]中[嗯呢炮塔]展开导弹舱的持续时间增加至12秒；任意招式中的[破甲弹头]或[高爆弹头]命中敌人时，使敌人的全属性伤害抗性降低15%，持续15秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
cinema.descriptionEn: The duration of the En-Nah Turret's missile bay deployed by EX Special Attack: Explosive Experiment increases to 12s. When an Armor-Piercing Warhead or High-Explosive Warhead from any skill hits an enemy, the target's All-Attribute RES is reduced by 15% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

cinema.name: 万物统一公理
cinema.description: [额外能力：集群优势]中，每层[技术鸿沟]提供的失衡易伤倍率提升至6%；诺姆处于接战状态下发动[普通攻击：帽子把戏]时，回复25点能量，20秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: The Stun DMG Multiplier granted by each stack of Tech Divide in Norma's Additional Ability: Advantage in Numbers is increased to 6%. When Norma uses Basic Attack: Hat Trick while in combat, she gains 25 Energy. This effect can trigger once every 20s.

cinema.name: 天生反派佯谬
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 优势邦布学说
cinema.description: 诺姆消耗[预热膛温]触发[连携技]时：使诺姆和对应代理人回复200点喧响值。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Norma consumes Preheated Chamber to trigger a Chain Attack, both Norma and the corresponding Agent gain 200 Decibels.

cinema.name: 嗯呢大爆炸
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 天才第一因
cinema.description: 队伍中任意角色使敌人进入失衡状态后，诺姆将不断召唤导弹轰击场上随机敌人，持续6秒，每发导弹间隔0.75秒，并对范围内敌人造成等同于诺姆200%攻击力的火属性伤害，该伤害会被视为[终结技]伤害，重复触发刷新持续时间，30秒内最多触发一次；诺姆的[破甲弹头]造成的失衡值提升30%，[高爆弹头]造成的伤害提升30%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After any squad member Stuns an enemy, Norma will continuously summon missiles to bombard random enemies on the field for 6s. A missile is launched every 0.75s, dealing Fire DMG equal to 200% of Norma's ATK to enemies within the area. This DMG is considered Ultimate DMG. Repeated triggers reset the duration. This effect can trigger once every 30s. The Daze inflicted by Armor-Piercing Warhead increases by 30%, and the DMG dealt by High-Explosive Warhead increases by 30%.

basic.name: 普通攻击：工程保险
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成火属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to four attacks forward, dealing Fire DMG.

basic.name: 普通攻击：帽子把戏
basic.description:
诺姆为当前操作角色，且处于接战状态时，每秒获得1.5%[预热膛温]；
头上有[随行礼帽]时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
炮击后扔出[随行礼帽]，令[随行礼帽]发动一轮空中射击，造成火属性伤害，并暂存[预热膛温]；
招式命中敌人时，将触发上一位角色的[快速支援]，5秒内最多触发一次；
[随行礼帽]被扔出后，会代替诺姆以相同的速度累积并暂存[预热膛温]，期间诺姆无需在前场；
诺姆重新拾取[随行礼帽]后，将立即获得暂存的[预热膛温]；
长按 【普通攻击键】 时， [随行礼帽]会加速跑向诺姆；
当诺姆拾取[随行礼帽]后的[预热膛温]能够达到80%时，[随行礼帽]会自动加速跑向诺姆；
当诺姆从前场切换至后场，且处于接战状态时，若[预热膛温]未满，[随行礼帽]会自动跳入战场；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
basic.descriptionEn:
When Norma is the active character and is in combat, she gains 1.5% Preheated Chamber per second.
When Top Hat Companion is on her head, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
After firing, Norma throws out Top Hat Companion, ordering it to unleash a round of aerial fire, dealing Fire DMG and storing the current Preheated Chamber.
When the skill hits an enemy, it triggers the previous character's Quick Assist. This effect can trigger once every 5s.
Once Top Hat Companion has been thrown out, it will accumulate and retain Preheated Chamber at the same speed on behalf of Norma. Norma does not need to stay on the field during this period.
After Norma retrieves the Top Hat Companion, she immediately gains the stored Preheated Chamber.
When holding [Basic Attack], the Top Hat Companion will accelerate toward Norma.
If retrieving the Top Hat Companion would raise Preheated Chamber to 80% or higher, the Top Hat Companion will automatically accelerate toward Norma.
When Norma switches from on field to off field while in combat, if Preheated Chamber is not full, Top Hat Companion automatically enters the battlefield.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：死线冲刺
basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
旋转并对周围开火，造成火属性伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Spins while firing at nearby enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

ex.name: 特殊技：高温熔断
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
炮击，造成火属性伤害。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Bombards enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：嗯呢弹幕
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
驾驶炮塔连续射击并根据敌人状态发射不同类型的导弹：
主要攻击目标未处于失衡状态时，发射破甲弹头，造成火属性伤害并累积较多失衡值；
主要攻击目标处于失衡状态时，发射高爆弹头，造成更高火属性伤害；
招式发动后，诺姆获得16%[预热膛温]，并进入[嗯呢弹幕]状态，持续32秒，[嗯呢弹幕]状态期间，诺姆会放置两座[嗯呢炮塔]加入战斗；
保持长按可以持续消耗能量并延长最多2秒射击时间，每通过长按消耗1点能量，诺姆额外获得0.4%[预热膛温]，并使本轮[嗯呢弹幕]状态的持续时间额外增加0.8秒，最多增加32秒；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Operates the turret to fire continuously and launch different types of missiles based on the target's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launches an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing Fire DMG and inflicting a large amount of Daze.
When the primary target is Stunned, launches a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater Fire DMG.
After using this skill, Norma gains 16% Preheated Chamber and enters the En-Nah Barrage state for 32s. While En-Nah Barrage is active, Norma deploys two En-Nah Turrets to join the battle.
Continuing to hold extends the firing time by up to 2s, continuously consuming energy. For each 1 point of energy consumed while holding, Norma gains an additional 0.4% Preheated Chamber, and this round of En-Nah Barrage lasts 0.8s longer, up to a maximum additional duration of 32s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 特殊技：打靶练习
ex.description: 战斗中，[嗯呢炮塔]会自动对敌人发动攻击， 造成火属性伤害。
ex.descriptionEn: During battle, En-Nah Turret automatically attacks enemies, dealing Fire DMG.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：火力实验
ex.description:
队伍中任意角色使敌人进入失衡状态时，或是诺姆消耗[预热膛温]触发[连携技]时，[嗯呢炮塔]会展开导弹舱，持续8秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
期间，[嗯呢炮塔]的自动攻击间隔减少，自动攻击时根据敌人状态额外发射不同类型的导弹：
主要攻击目标未处于失衡状态时，发射破甲弹头，造成火属性伤害并累积较多失衡值；
主要攻击目标处于失衡状态时，发射高爆弹头，造成更高火属性伤害；
ex.descriptionEn:
When any squad member Stuns an enemy, or when Norma consumes Preheated Chamber to trigger a Chain Attack, En-Nah Turret deploys its missile bay for 8s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
During this time, En-Nah Turrets automatically attack more frequently. When performing automatic attacks, they launch different missiles based on the enemy's state:
When the primary target is not Stunned, launch an Armor-Piercing Warhead, dealing Fire DMG and inflicting a large amount of Daze.
When the primary target is Stunned, launch a High-Explosive Warhead, dealing greater Fire DMG.

ultimate.name: 终结技：优势火力学说
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
召唤战术火炮轰炸前方敌人，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动时，立刻获得30%[预热膛温]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Calls in tactical artillery to bombard enemies ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, immediately gains 30% Preheated Chamber.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：隆隆援护
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
令隆隆钻头进行持续钻击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Commands the Rumble Drill to continuously attack the target, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
